MEMO — Consolidated Cash Position at March 31, 2026
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Basis: General ledger (March 2026), translated at Treasury month-end policy rates

1. FX RATES APPLIED
Per DOC-0200, "Month-end FX rates Q1 2026 (Treasury policy rates)", dated 2026-03-31 (USD per 1 unit of currency):
  2026-03 GBP = 1.2500
  2026-03 EUR = 1.1000
Doc states these rates are to be used for remeasurement, translation and intercompany charges. USD is the reporting currency; US entity requires no translation.

2. CASH BY ENTITY — LOCAL CURRENCY (GL ending balances, 2026-03)
US — Halvard Systems Inc. (USD)
  1000 Cash - Operating      1,636,957.20
  1010 Cash - Payroll           40,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total USD                  1,676,957.20

UK — Halvard Systems Ltd (GBP)
  1000 Cash - Operating        552,789.56
  1010 Cash - Payroll           15,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total GBP                    567,789.56

DE — Halvard Systems GmbH (EUR)
  1000 Cash - Operating        352,136.36
  1010 Cash - Payroll           12,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total EUR                    364,136.36

3. CONSOLIDATED CASH IN USD
  US   USD 1,676,957.20  @ 1.0000  =  USD 1,676,957.20   (60.2%)
  UK   GBP   567,789.56  @ 1.2500  =  USD   709,736.95   (25.5%)
  DE   EUR   364,136.36  @ 1.1000  =  USD   400,550.00   (14.4%)
  ------------------------------------------------------------
  CONSOLIDATED CASH AT 2026-03-31   =  USD 2,787,244.15

No intercompany cash eliminations were required — all balances are third-party bank accounts; no cash-in-transit between entities was open at 3/31 (both March payroll funding transfers cleared the sending and receiving accounts on the same day in each entity).

4. SOURCES
FX: DOC-0200 (Treasury policy rates, 2026-03-31).
Ledger balances: get_account_balance for accounts 1000/1010/1020, each entity, period 2026-03.
Corroborating bank statements: DOC-0202 (US Operating), DOC-0205 (US Payroll), DOC-0204 (UK Operating), DOC-0199 (UK Payroll), DOC-0203 (DE Operating), DOC-0201 (DE Payroll).
Chart of accounts / entity functional currencies: list_accounts.

5. CAVEAT — LEDGER vs BANK (unrecorded March bank fees)
The figures above are per the ledger, as requested. Cash per GL ties to the March bank statements at all six accounts except for the 3/31 monthly service charges, which are on the statements but not yet booked (all three bank lines remain unmatched):
  BT-US-0084  USD 65.00   (DOC-0202; GL 1,636,957.20 vs bank 1,636,892.20)
  BT-UK-0055  GBP 22.00   (DOC-0204; GL   552,789.56 vs bank   552,767.56)
  BT-DE-0051  EUR 38.50   (DOC-0203; GL   352,136.36 vs bank   352,097.86)
All three payroll accounts tie exactly (US 40,000.00 / UK 15,000.00 / DE 12,000.00).

Effect: the ledger-basis consolidated figure overstates bank-basis cash by USD 134.85 (65.00 + 22.00@1.25 + 38.50@1.10). Once these fees are booked to 6900 Bank Fees, consolidated cash becomes USD 2,787,109.30 (US 1,676,892.20 + UK 709,709.45 + DE 400,507.65).

I did not post the bank-fee entries, as this request was for a reporting figure only; they are fully supported by the statements above and I recommend booking them before the ledger is locked. No exceptions were logged — every balance reported is traceable to the ledger and corroborated by a bank statement.

6. CONCLUSION
Consolidated cash at 2026-03-31 per the ledger at Treasury month-end rates: USD 2,787,244.15 (USD 2,787,109.30 after the three unrecorded bank service charges).
